name: hold-button
title: Hold to Confirm
description: Hold to fill the button and confirm the action.
useCases: Before clearing a draft, the author holds the button to confirm. Releasing it early preserves the text.
At a kiosk, an operator holds the session reset button. The app starts the reset after onConfirm.
task: Hold to fill the button and confirm the action.
behavior: duration and resetAfter are in milliseconds. Attach the action to onConfirm, which fires after a completed hold.
